timer.title: Timer Settings
timer.focusMinHelp: Duration of focused work sessions (1 to 180 min)
timer.shortBreakMinHelp: Brief pause between focus sessions (1 to 60 min)
timer.longBreakMinHelp: Extended rest after completing a cycle (1 to 120 min)
timer.cyclesUntilLongHelp: Number of focus sessions before a long break (2 to 12)
timer.autoStartBreaksHelp: Start break timer automatically when focus completes
timer.autoStartFocusHelp: Start next focus session automatically when break ends

sound.title: Sound & Alerts
sound.soundEnabledHelp: Plays a soft chime when each phase finishes
sound.alertSecondsHelp: How long the mascot and clock stay in alert state (3 to 60 s)
sound.notifyOnExpireHelp: Displays an OS notification in Windows Action Center on expiration

overlay.title: Floating Overlay
overlay.clockStyleHelp: Choose the visual design of the timer interface
overlay.themeClasicoDesc: Digital pill with clear display and accessible controls
overlay.themeAnilloDesc: Concentric circular progress with time in the center
overlay.themeBarraDesc: Stylized horizontal bar with continuous progress line
overlay.themeMinimalistaDesc: Discreet typography with status indicator dot and hover controls
overlay.scaleHelp: Size of the clock and mascot (50% to 200%)
overlay.opacityHelp: Transparency level of the overlay (30% to 100%)
overlay.companionDialogueHelp: Displays motivational speech bubbles and wellness tips at key moments
overlay.clickThroughHelp: Mouse clicks pass through to windows beneath
overlay.clickThroughWarning: Note: to regain direct mouse control, disable this from the system tray icon.
overlay.resetPositionHelp: Moves the overlay to the bottom-right corner of the primary display

pets.title: Available Mascots
pets.subtitle: Choose the companion that keeps you company while working
pets.author: Author

general.title: General Preferences
general.autostartHelp: Run PomoPet automatically when logging into Windows
general.reducedMotionHelp: Controls mascot animations and visual transitions
